summary: RE-REVIEW after the rebase onto f4005905 (#963 merged). The pin at 5debadf2 is void and its record is deleted in this same commit. REBASE INTEGRITY PROVEN, NOT ASSUMED: I stripped blob-hash and hunk-offset lines from both diffs and compared the 561 changed content lines directly — BYTE-IDENTICAL to the head I pinned. The review below therefore stands unchanged. READ-ONLY ANALYSIS HARNESS; no runtime code, no deploy, no restart. IT ANSWERS THE METHOD WARNING I GAVE AND ITS DOCSTRING LEADS WITH IT: 'Reconstruct live exit-rejection episodes without counting client aborts as venue refusals.' That matters because broker_order_events records OUR OWN CLIENT ABORTS AS REJECTS, so every raw reject count in this repo starts contaminated, and the operator was being shown a claimed count of 45 built on that contamination. The classifier keys on EVENT SOURCE rather than a reason string: sources == [broker] is a venue_refusal, sources == [client] is a client_abort, sources == [unknown] stays unknown, and anything else is reported as 'mixed:' with the sources named rather than forced into a bucket. Reporting mixed instead of guessing is the right call and is the difference between a census and a number someone will quote later. It splits by ACCOUNT and PROVIDER, which this data requires — live:orb refuses a different class than Schwab and at roughly 18x the volume, so a pooled count is uninterpretable. And it defaults the cutover to PR #946's merge instant while stating in the code that this is a DEPLOYMENT BOUNDARY AND NOT PROOF OF BEHAVIOUR CHANGE — that is harm-analysis-window discipline applied correctly; without it a census bills pre-fix behaviour as live, which is exactly the DUP2/#848 mistake. It also refuses to run during regular market hours, matching the operator's standing rule about load on the trading box. MUTATIONS, both RED: making every reject count as a venue_refusal fails test_client_abort_never_counts_as_a_venue_refusal; ignoring the cutover so everything lands in one window fails test_cutover_splits_the_same_position_into_pre_and_post. Controlled full unit pair vs the NEW base f4005905: base 46 failed / 3743 passed, head 46 failed / 3755 passed, ZERO new failure names and ZERO fixed, with the base worktree's existence verified before trusting the comparison. Ancestor PASS. Reviewer differs from the author. ⚠ SCOPE, SO NOBODY OVER-READS ITS FIRST OUTPUT: this reconstructs and classifies episodes. It does NOT establish that any refusal class is our defect, and no number from it has been shown to the operator yet. Its first run produces a starting point for investigation, not a finding. No blocking findings.
